name: H2O-3 (H2O Flow web UI + REST API)

vendor.backing: OSS (Apache-2.0) with a commercial company behind it; H2O-3 is the free open-source core, while Driverless AI, H2O MLOps, Document AI, Hydrogen Torch, and the newer GenAI/agentic stack are the commercial products
vendor.scale: Founded 2012. ~7k GitHub stars on h2o-3. Total funding ~$250M (Series E led by Commonwealth Bank of Australia; earlier Series C led by Wells Fargo and NVIDIA). Vendor claims >20,000 organizations, ~1M+ data scientists, and over half the Fortune 500 use the broader platform (AT&T, Citi, Capital One, GSK, PayPal, Walgreens cited). H2O-3 itself is one of the most widely deployed open-source AutoML/distributed-ML engines.

ports: 54321/tcp (H2O Flow UI + REST API, embedded Jetty, plaintext HTTP by default; HTTPS only if -jks set)
54322/tcp (proprietary binary intra-cluster node-to-node protocol, unencrypted by default)

verification_primitive.probe: HTTP GET http://<host>:54321/3/Cloud (read-only; also GET /3/About). No auth header. Single GET, no state change.
verification_primitive.success_signal: HTTP 200 with application/json body containing the H2O-specific keys cloud_name, build_number, node_idx, cloud_healthy, and a nodes[] array with member IP:port and version. A login prompt (401/redirect to a form) instead means auth IS enabled = not open.
verification_primitive.impact_when_open: A 200-with-data here proves the cluster is fully unauthenticated: the same session can list Frames (/3/Frames) and Models (/3/Models) to read loaded datasets and their column/schema names, enumerate the server filesystem via /3/Typeahead/files, and reach the ImportFiles / ImportSQLTable ingestion endpoints. On builds <= 3.46.0.8 those ingestion endpoints are the unauthenticated JDBC-deserialization RCE sink. Restraint: /3/Cloud read alone confirms exposure; do not exercise the RCE sink.

endpoints.returns: H2O Flow single-page web UI (notebook). Loads with no login on a default instance; full point-and-click control of the cluster.
Cluster status JSON: version, build_number, node names, node IP:port list, healthy flag, member node H2O versions, memory/CPU. Best single unauth fingerprint + recon read.
Build/version metadata JSON (H2O version, build branch, build age, JVM, OS). Vendor-unique keys.
All Frames (datasets) in the DKV - frame keys, column names, row counts. Reveals what data is loaded; column names leak schema/PII fields.
All trained models in the DKV with algorithm and parameters - the org's ML IP.
All running/finished jobs (long-running actions), exposing activity and operator usage.
Server-side filesystem path autocomplete - enumerate the host filesystem of the H2O node unauthenticated.
Imports a server-side file/URL path into a Frame - lets an unauth client read arbitrary server-readable files and SSRF-style fetch URLs the node can reach.
Imports a SQL table via a caller-supplied connection_url JDBC string - the JDBC deserialization RCE sink (CVE-2024-45758 / CVE-2025-5662 / 6507 / 6544 / 10769).
Lists keys in node persistent storage categories.
Hive import and parse drivers - additional data-ingestion / connection-string attack surface.
